    Class GameContext

    Centralized context object that provides access to all core game services through dependency injection. This class serves as a service aggregator that collects all essential game systems into a single, easily injectable dependency for game states and other complex systems.

    Namespace: GameFramework.Core

    Syntax
    public class GameContext
    Remarks

    The GameContext follows the Context Object pattern, providing a clean way to pass multiple related services to classes that need access to various game systems. Rather than injecting each service individually, classes can inject the GameContext and access all services through it.

    Benefits:

    • Reduces constructor parameter count in dependent classes
    • Provides a stable interface even when service dependencies change
    • Centralizes service access for easier testing and mocking
    • Maintains clear dependency relationships through constructor injection

    All services are validated for null values during construction, ensuring that the GameContext is always in a valid state when successfully created.

    Examples
    // In a game state constructor
public class PlayingState : IGameState
{
    private readonly GameContext _context;

    public PlayingState(GameContext context)
    {
        _context = context;
    }

    public void Enter()
    {
        _context.AudioService.PlayMusic("gameplay");
        _context.UIService.ShowScreen("hud");
        _context.EventSystem.Publish(new GameStartedEvent());
    }
}

    Remarks

    This constructor uses dependency injection to receive all core game services. All parameters are validated for null values, ensuring that the GameContext is always created in a valid state with all required dependencies.

    The constructor is designed to be called by the dependency injection container during application startup. Manual instantiation is not recommended as it requires managing all service dependencies manually.

    Examples
    // Typically handled by DI container
container.RegisterSingleton<GameContext>();

// Container automatically provides all dependencies
var context = container.Resolve<GameContext>();
    Exceptions
    Type Condition
    ArgumentNullException

    Thrown when any of the required service parameters is null.
